up: Return a list of all approved drugs where the mechanism of action is an inhibitor. Include the compound name (pref_name), ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the mechanism of action, and the target name (pref_name) and ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.molregno, md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, dm.mechanism_of_action, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name FROM drug_mechanism dm JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND dm.action_type = 'INHIBITOR';
